MANOSABA_LIN_EVENT_GUARD_ONE_EVENT.title: Guard's Trial
MANOSABA_LIN_EVENT_GUARD_ONE_EVENT.pages: By the campfire, you encounter a mysterious guard. He offers two trials:
Gain 13 max HP, upgrade a card, but the Boss will be replaced by a Guard
You accepted the Power Trial. Max HP increased, card upgraded. But the Boss ahead has been replaced...
You accepted the Healing Trial. HP restored, card upgraded.
MANOSABA_LIN_EVENT_KINMANEYURAKUCHO_EVEN:
You walk into an abandoned amusement park. Neon lights flicker, and the air smells of sweet caramel.
A person in a clown costume steps out from behind a carousel, grinning at you:
[color=#cccccc]"Welcome to Kinma Amusement Park! Pick a game — each one has a price~"[/color]

Pay {GoldCost} gold. Choose 4 cards to transform.
[color=#cccccc]"Turn the old into new — isn't that fun?"[/color]

Give up a random relic. Upgrade 6 cards.
[color=#cccccc]"You have to give something up to become stronger~"[/color]

Lose {HpCost} HP. Remove 4 cards.
[color=#cccccc]"Throw away all the junk! Travel light~"[/color]

The cards twist and deform in your hands, becoming something entirely new.
You chose 'Warm Lies,' but the new cards are real.

You hand over the potion. Your cards are renewed, power flowing through you.
You chose 'Their Story,' and the story continues.

You feel a sharp pain, then an unprecedented lightness.
You chose 'Truth Seeker,' discarding what was unnecessary.
The clown shakes his head: [color=#cccccc]"Not enough gold~ Go earn some and come back!"[/color]
The clown tilts his head: [color=#cccccc]"No relics to trade? Then you can't play this game~"[/color]
